user_query: I need assistance with finding suggestions for search queries related to 'technology'. Can you provide me with a tool that offers this functionality? It would be helpful if the tool also allows customization of the initial keyword.

TaskList.description: Identify a suitable tool or API that provides search query suggestions based on a given keyword.
Request customization options for the selected tool, enabling users to modify the initial keyword for tailored suggestions.
Retrieve search query suggestions using the identified tool and customized parameters.
